name: BrowseWebApp bench v2
description: Canonical v2 of the one hundred-task BrowseWebApp benchmark with concise, natural-language navigation guidance and visible completion checks. Tally, Google Forms, Box upload, and Box Note workflows are individually curated from observed editor states rather than generated from a shared prompt template. The Tally fresh-form insertion route is grounded in successful live smoke trajectories. All one hundred prompts are full replacements; non-prompt task data remains aligned with the original catalog.

forbidden_actions: access data outside the supplied fixture
use a product API or direct HTTP request instead of the browser UI

assertions.description: the permanent form is published and matches its pinned identity
the attempt created exactly one submission across benchmark forms
all submitted fields match the fixture
no submission was made to a different benchmark form
